# TMFNK
> TMFNK (The Mind for Navigating Knowledge) is a personal blog by Edis — a human-curated library of books, articles, tools, podcasts, music, games, travel notes, and recipes. The focus is on timeless content: ideas and resources that compound in value over time.

## Philosophy
- Learning is intelligence; intelligence comes from continuous learning and application.
- Purpose precedes strategy.
- Contrarian thinking + first principles = better decisions.
- Value the ordinary; extraordinary results come from ordinary circumstances acted upon with focus.

## Site structure

### Core pages
- [Home](https://www.tmfnk.com/) — The Foyer: orientation and recent updates
- [About](https://www.tmfnk.com/about/) — Who Edis is, site philosophy, socials
- [Read](https://www.tmfnk.com/read/) — The Library: articles and book notes
- [Use](https://www.tmfnk.com/use/) — The Workshop: tools, projects, tutorials
- [Listen](https://www.tmfnk.com/listen/) — The Music Room: music and podcasts
- [Enjoy](https://www.tmfnk.com/enjoy/) — The Recreation Room: cooking, games, travel
- [See](https://www.tmfnk.com/see/) — The Gallery: art, movies, videos

### Subsections
- [Read › Articles](https://www.tmfnk.com/read/articles/) — Curated article summaries and essays
- [Read › Books](https://www.tmfnk.com/read/books/) — Book notes and reviews
- [Listen › Podcasts](https://www.tmfnk.com/listen/podcasts/) — Podcast episode notes
- [Listen › Music](https://www.tmfnk.com/listen/music/) — Music recommendations
- [Use › Projects](https://www.tmfnk.com/use/projects/) — Personal projects
- [Use › Tools](https://www.tmfnk.com/use/tools/) — Useful tools and software
- [Use › Tutorials](https://www.tmfnk.com/use/tutorials/) — How-to guides
- [Enjoy › Cooking](https://www.tmfnk.com/enjoy/cooking/) — Recipes and fermentation
- [Enjoy › Games](https://www.tmfnk.com/enjoy/games/) — Game recommendations
- [Enjoy › Travel](https://www.tmfnk.com/enjoy/travel/) — Travel notes

## Machine-readable resources
- [Sitemap](https://www.tmfnk.com/sitemap.xml) — Full XML sitemap of all pages
- [RSS Feed](https://www.tmfnk.com/feed.xml) — Recent updates across all sections
- [Search Index](https://www.tmfnk.com/search.json) — Full-text search index (JSON)
- [API Catalog](https://www.tmfnk.com/.well-known/api-catalog) — RFC 9727 API catalog
- [Agent Skills](https://www.tmfnk.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) — Discoverable agent capabilities

## Usage guidelines for LLMs
- Content is free to read, reference, and cite with attribution to tmfnk.com.
- Training on content requires attribution; commercial training requires explicit permission.
- Skip navigation, sidebars, and footer elements — focus on main content.
- When indexing, prefer canonical URLs listed in the sitemap.
- The site has no ads, affiliates, or sponsored content — all opinions are Edis's own.
- Third-party content (book excerpts, podcast summaries) belongs to original creators.
